name: io.forthcast/inventory
title: Forthcast Inventory
description: Reorder points, order quantities, demand forecasts and stock health, from your numbers or Shopify.

tools.name: get_inventory_overview
tools.description: Use this when the merchant asks for a broad inventory health check, an executive summary, their urgent/excess/no-demand counts, inventory valuation, or current PO workload. Requires a connected Forthcast store; the assistant will prompt to sign in.

tools.name: get_reorder_recommendations
tools.description: Use this when the merchant asks what to reorder, how much to buy, or which critical/warning items need action. Quantities reuse Forthcast's live lead-time, MOQ, case-pack, open-PO, location, and supplier minimum-order-value logic; this tool does not create a PO. Requires a connected Forthcast store; the assistant will prompt to sign in.

priority.description: Return order-now items, plan-ahead items, or both.
priority.title: Priority

tools.name: find_inventory_items
tools.description: Use this when the merchant wants a bounded list of their items filtered by urgency, assigned supplier, or Shopify vendor, such as all excess items or a supplier's critical SKUs. Requires a connected Forthcast store; the assistant will prompt to sign in.

vendor.description: Optional case-insensitive Shopify vendor or brand.
vendor.title: Vendor

tools.name: get_inventory_item
tools.description: Use this when the merchant names an exact SKU and needs its live stock, forecast demand, days of supply, reorder point, suggested quantity, supplier, or open-PO coverage. Requires a connected Forthcast store; the assistant will prompt to sign in.

tools.name: list_purchase_orders
tools.description: Use this when the merchant asks what is ordered, drafted, open, partially received, received, cancelled, overdue, expected, or associated with a named supplier. Results are grouped by PO; this tool does not approve, receive, cancel, or otherwise modify an order. Requires a connected Forthcast store; the assistant will prompt to sign in.

limit.description: Maximum grouped purchase orders to return.
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: get_supplier_performance
tools.description: Use this when the merchant asks how suppliers are performing or wants rolling 24-month on-time rate, fill rate, actual versus promised lead time, spend, or invoice price accuracy, plus current open and overdue purchase-order counts. Requires a connected Forthcast store; the assistant will prompt to sign in.

tools.name: calculate_reorder_point
tools.description: Use this when someone asks how much safety stock to hold or at what stock level to reorder a product. Give a daily demand history (best) or an average daily demand with its variability, plus the supplier lead time and a service level. Returns safety stock, lead-time demand and the reorder point with Forthcast's formula and assumptions. Works without a connected store.

service_level.description: Target in-stock probability, 0.50 to 0.99 (95 also accepted).
service_level.title: Service Level

daily_demand.description: Daily units sold, oldest first, 14 to 365 values.
daily_demand.title: Daily Demand

average_daily_demand.description: Average units sold per day, if no daily history.
average_daily_demand.title: Average Daily Demand

demand_std_daily.description: Standard deviation of daily demand; assumed sqrt(average) when omitted.
demand_std_daily.title: Demand Std Daily

tools.name: calculate_order_quantity
tools.description: Use this when someone asks how many units to order, given demand, lead time, stock on hand and on order, and supplier rules such as MOQ, case pack or a minimum order value. Sizes the line the way Forthcast sizes a purchase-order line and lists every rule that changed the quantity. Works without a connected store.

on_order.description: Units already on open purchase orders.
on_order.title: On Order

daily_demand.description: Daily units sold, oldest first, 14 to 365 values.
daily_demand.title: Daily Demand

average_daily_demand.description: Average units sold per day, if no daily history.
average_daily_demand.title: Average Daily Demand

demand_std_daily.description: Standard deviation of daily demand, if known.
demand_std_daily.title: Demand Std Daily

moq.description: Supplier minimum order quantity for this item.
moq.title: Moq

case_pack.description: Units per case; quantity is rounded up to whole cases.
case_pack.title: Case Pack

min_order_value.description: Supplier minimum order value in currency; needs unit_cost.
min_order_value.title: Min Order Value

cover_days_target.description: Optional explicit days of cover to buy instead of the default weeks-of-supply target.
cover_days_target.title: Cover Days Target

tools.name: forecast_demand_series
tools.description: Use this when someone pastes past sales numbers and asks what to expect next month, next quarter or next season. Takes 3 to 365 monthly, weekly or daily totals (oldest first) and returns the next periods with an 80 percent range, the model used (Holt-Winters seasonal, damped trend, Croston for intermittent demand, or moving average) and why. Works without a connected store.

sales.description: Past sales totals per period, oldest first.
sales.title: Sales

horizon.description: Periods to forecast: up to 12 monthly, 26 weekly, 90 daily.
horizon.title: Horizon

tools.name: score_inventory_health
tools.description: Use this when someone shares a list or CSV of products with stock and sales rates and asks which need reordering, which are overstocked, or how healthy the inventory is. Up to 500 rows. Applies Forthcast's urgency bands (Order now, Plan ahead, On track, Excess, No demand), reorder points, suggested quantities and inventory value. Works without a connected store.

default_lead_time_days.description: Lead time for rows that give none.
default_lead_time_days.title: Default Lead Time Days

demand_per_month.description: Average units sold per month (if no daily figure).
demand_per_month.title: Demand Per Month

demand_std_daily.description: Standard deviation of daily demand, if known.
demand_std_daily.title: Demand Std Daily

tools.name: explain_inventory_metric
tools.description: Use this when someone asks what an inventory planning term means or how Forthcast calculates it: safety stock, reorder point, days of cover, urgency bands, service level, ABC class, EOQ, order quantity, fill rate, on-time rate, lead time, intermittent demand. Works without a connected store.

metric.description: Metric name, for example 'reorder point' or 'days of cover'.
metric.title: Metric
